source: Independent planning subagent plan_task_next; root accepted subject to preregistration review; not external WebChat
scientific_question: Can the fixed task network retain hybrid-reference economics within a preregistered loss tolerance on unseen seeds and known frozen opponents?
reason: Actual task control and near-reference development performance are sufficient to test generalization; avoid further tuning to the two consumed validation seeds
seed_requirements: Explicit new configuration; exclude all historical train/development/test and registered unused reserved seeds, including market192 panel
execution: All games through repaired real official filename loader; protected models and fixed full source dependency/official loader/opponent hashes; local preregistration commit before first match

statistics.primary: paired net-profit difference divided by reference mean net profit; net profit=final minus initial cash
statistics.cluster: whole seed retaining all opponent-seat-arm pairs
statistics.interval: two-sided95%, re-estimate ratio numerator and denominator per resample
statistics.denominator: Reference mean net profit must be strictly positive for every reported ratio; otherwise primary gate undefined and no admission

gate_interpretation: 2% is a declared engineering tolerance, not a natural game threshold; per-opponent point guards are not statistical noninferiority guarantees; passing is restricted panel ability retention, not stronger-than-teacher
stop: Any official error, timeout, identity/privacy/audit failure stops new dispatch; no retries/replacement. After each complete seed stop if student mean final cash <50% reference, mark safety stop with no confirmatory inference. Never stop early for success.
independent_review: Preselect first and last seed student-versus-market both seats (4 saved replay audits); separately recompute all96 ledger/statistics/hashes. Root audits all96; independent scope explicit.
failed_gate: Retain fixed research model, consume all tested seeds permanently; only a separate later zero-training diagnosis, no retuning/retest on these seeds
